evidence.note: This contemporaneous company disclosure describes gains and maximal-budget evaluations. It provides neither controlled negative task-level sweeps nor sufficiently comprehensive sweeps to establish the contradiction condition.

reviews.rationale: The packet does not establish a task where additional inference compute fails to help. Its reported gains also do not establish improvement across all relevant task categories. Uneven cross-model results cannot settle the claimed compute effect.
